name: Amposta (Spain)
description: Red field with a yellow pale of four red pales along the hoist, charged at the centre of the fly with a white Maltese cross.
history: The official flag of Amposta is oblong, of proportions two high by three long, red, with a yellow pale charged with four red pales of thickness 3/11 of the length of the cloth at the hoist, and a white Maltese cross of 5/11 of the height. It was approved by the municipal council on 26 March 2007; its symbolism evokes the Hospitaller lordship over the town. Previously a white flag with a red cross patty, which did not accurately represent the cross of the Hospital, had been used.

features.role: pale of four red pales on yellow along the hoist
